% ---------- Summary ----------
\section*{}
Physics graduate who taught himself modern ML engineering by building it: fine-tuned a 3B-parameter hybrid-architecture LLM for latent reasoning on free Kaggle GPUs, built a full-stack agent-harness platform (FastAPI + Next.js + llama.cpp), and shipped production chatbots and scraping pipelines for various products. Comfortable across the entire stack - from custom PyTorch training loops and LoRA adapters to SSE streaming APIs, terminal-grade frontends, and CI/. Looking for an AI/ML or Full Stack engineering role where shipping fast matters more than pedigree.

% ---------- Projects ----------
\section*{Projects}

\entryheader{\href{https://github.com/deveshpat/Ouroboros}{\textit{Ouroboros}} - Latent-reasoning LLM fine-tuning framework}
{Mar '26 - Present}
{\textit{\small PyTorch $\cdot$ HuggingFace Transformers $\cdot$ PEFT/LoRA $\cdot$ bitsandbytes $\cdot$ Kaggle GPUs $\cdot$ Weights \& Biases}}{}
\vspace{-10pt}
\begin{tightitemize}
    \item Implemented Coconut-style latent reasoning on AI21's Jamba-Reasoning-3B (hybrid attention/Mamba/MoE): a custom \texttt{JambaForCausalLM} subclass runs latent passes inside \texttt{forward()}, triggered by \texttt{<|lat|>} tokens, with a learned halt gate for adaptive compute.
    \item Built a curriculum trainer (subclassing HF \texttt{Trainer}) with a custom DGAC loss, LoRA adapters targeting attention + Mamba SSM + MoE expert projections, and adapter-only checkpointing.
    \item Engineered cross-session training resume with HuggingFace Hub sync to run multi-day training within free Kaggle session limits; 4-bit quantized inference for edge deployment; CPU smoke-test suite for GPU-free iteration.
\end{tightitemize}

\vspace{5pt}
\entryheader{\href{https://github.com/deveshpat/EdgeRunner}{\textit{EdgeRunner}} - Agent harness \& local-model serving platform}{Mar '26 - Present}
{\textit{\small FastAPI $\cdot$ Next.js (App Router) $\cdot$ TypeScript $\cdot$ Tailwind $\cdot$ llama.cpp $\cdot$ SSE $\cdot$ Cloudflare Tunnel $\cdot$ pytest $\cdot$ GitHub Actions}}
\vspace{-10pt}
\begin{tightitemize}
    \item Built an end-to-end platform for running tool-calling LLM agents on remote GPUs: FastAPI backend with a model/harness catalog, streaming chat endpoint, and pluggable harnesses (mock echo + live llama.cpp via OpenAI-compatible API).

    \item Shipped a terminal-themed Next.js chat UI with token streaming, model/harness pickers, and an in-browser code runner; backend covered by a pytest suite and GitHub Actions CI.
\end{tightitemize}
